shipLog.text: ◆ Station approach. Life support here is maintained by the lowest bidder. MARV has met the lowest bidder. He would like to be undocked by evening.
◆ Crop planted. MARV notes this is the point of no return. The mission now depends on something that needs water and doesn't respond to reason.
Arrived: New Somewhere. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
The Paperwork. The captain chose “Sign everything without reading”. Noted.
You signed. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Planetary approach. MARV has reviewed the atmosphere. It is breathable for things that are not us. Most atmospheres are.
Arrived: Asteroid Field 2. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ MARV notes that mining rocks like these is a real proposal, with real math, and realer skepticism.
◆ A repair kit went into the job.
Claim Jumper's Dilemma. The captain chose “Strip the rig for materials”. Noted.
Six hours of honest… −1 REPAIR KIT, +1 EXPERIMENTAL DRIVE COIL, +3 METAL, +2 SCRAP, 4 DAYS. It will not last.
Arrived: Technically Habitable. The leg cost +4 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The tomatoes are fine. The tomatoes are always either fine or in crisis. There is no middle state. (+2 morale)
The Green One. The captain chose “Send a crew member to investigate”. Noted.
Your crew member reports the vegetation is edible. REEVES −65 HP, −12 MORALE, +10 FOOD, 2 DAYS. As calculated.
◆ Reeves is wounded. Their skill is offline until they recover.
◆ We signed the waivers unread. I read them afterward. I have not shared what we agreed to. It would not help. Nothing does.
Tomato: VEGETATIVE. 32% grown, health 90. Temporarily.
Arrived: Route Decision. The leg cost −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, −3 HULL, +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ The drive coil misfires mid-burn. A bang, a smell, three points of hull. It keeps working, unrepentant.
Lane Closed for Works. The captain chose “Crawl through the works: port lane”. Noted.
You crawl through the slow zone at the posted speed, which is barely… −1 MORALE, 2 DAYS. As calculated.
◆ MARV ran a diagnostic on his pessimism module. It's functioning perfectly. He was afraid of that.
Arrived: FSS Whatever It Takes. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.

identity.name: Pip Andrade
identity.story: They are nineteen and lost the colony lottery four times. The fifth time, they stopped entering and started planning. They have a duffel bag, a forged cargo manifest that fooled nobody — the crew has known for a week and said nothing — and the specific unbeatable stubbornness of someone who has decided their life is happening whether invited or not.
identity.line: I'll work. I'll eat less than I work. You won't regret it — or you will, but not about me.
identity.join_note: No training, endless effort. The crew adopted them before you decided anything, which you will discover shortly.
